title: Immune Support Complex
body_html:
Immune Support Complex delivers comprehensive, everyday immune support in a single daily formula - so you can skip buying vitamin C, D3, zinc, and elderberry separately. Each two-capsule serving combines five essential vitamins and minerals with three targeted botanicals, all chosen to work together. It's designed for proactive adults who want to maintain their body's natural defenses year-round. Just two easy-to-swallow capsules a day make it simple to stay consistent.

At the heart of the formula are Vitamin D3 and Zinc, which promote a normal immune response and support healthy immune function. Vitamin C, Vitamin E, and citrus bioflavonoids add antioxidant support to help protect your cells from normal oxidative stress, while Vitamin B6 rounds out the nutrient base. We've paired these with Elderberry (Sambucus nigra) and Echinacea purpurea - two botanicals long valued for immune support - plus L-Lysine to complete the blend. The result is a thoughtfully balanced formula rather than a single-ingredient shortcut.

Whether you're navigating a busy travel schedule, managing a demanding routine, or simply committed to staying well, Immune Support Complex fits easily into your daily wellness habit. Give your immune system dependable, well-rounded support - one simple serving at a time.*


Ingredients: Vitamin C (as ascorbic acid) (180 mg), Vitamin D3 (as cholecalciferol) (40 mcg), Vitamin E (as d-alpha tocopheryl acetate) (15 mg), Vitamin B6 (as pyridoxal 5'-phosphate) (1.7 mg), Zinc (as zinc citrate) (11 mg), elderberry extract (Sambucus nigra) (fruit) (500 mg), Echinacea purpurea extract (whole plant) (200 mg), citrus bioflavonoids 50% (100 mg), and L-lysine (100 mg), gelatin (capsule), brown rice flour.
Manufacturer's country: USA
Product amount (oz/lb/g): 60 capsules / 1.7 oz / 0.10 lb / 46 g
Gross weight (oz/lb/g): 2.8 oz / 0.18 lb / 80 g
Suggested use: As a dietary supplement, adults take two (2) capsules daily. For best results, take with 6-8 oz (177-237ml) of water or as directed by healthcare professional.
CAUTION: Do not exceed recommended dose. Consult a physician if pregnant, nursing, under 18, or have a medical condition.
KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN. DO NOT USE IF SAFETY SEAL IS DAMAGED OR MISSING. STORE IN A COOL, DRY PLACE.

*These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.
